_comment: Base config for both builds. apps/api is CommonJS (NestJS decorator metadata) and cannot require() an ESM module; apps/web is bundled by Vite, and rollup cannot see named exports through a CJS file it did not interop-analyse. This package shipped CJS only until the web app imported its first runtime value rather than only types — at which point the build broke. Hence dist/cjs and dist/esm.
